name: Azure Machine Learning
sku: Azure Machine Learning (v2 platform). Training, the model catalog and prompt flow are not scored; prompt flow retires on 20 April 2027.

serve.ml-serving.note: Managed endpoints abstract the infrastructure for both batch and real-time scoring. Real-time endpoints answer over HTTPS and can split traffic across model deployments to test new versions.

bands.note: Studio with managed Jupyter notebooks, a drag-and-drop designer, an automated ML interface, the Python SDK v2, the Azure CLI and VS Code.

presentation.tagline: Managed ML lifecycle with real-time and batch model endpoints.
